name: token-weather
description: A live forecast of the context window above the prompt: a weather icon, the fill percentage, a chart of the last turns, then the 5-hour and 7-day usage windows with reset countdowns and the session cost. The band stacks over other mods' bands instead of hiding them.

placement.title: Where the line draws
placement.description: below: the hint row under the prompt (the engine's own hint follows it); above: the band above the prompt, stacked with other mods' bands

warnTokens.title: Warn from (tokens)
warnTokens.description: Context size at which the token count turns yellow, the ⚠2x long-context tag appears, and a toast fires once

dangerTokens.title: Danger from (tokens)
dangerTokens.description: Context size at which the token count turns red and a second toast fires once
